premises.text: The hiring process is broken for both job seekers and employers
Employers receive a large number of irrelevant job applications
premises.evidence_span: I get an inbox inundated with applications. I might get 300 applications, and out of those 300, 290 are a complete waste of time

premises.text: Job seekers want their applications to be noticed and to receive feedback
premises.evidence_span: job seekers want to get noticed

premises.text: Job seekers are willing to pay to apply for jobs on LocalBacon
premises.evidence_span: 75% of job seekers, 18 to 24, said they would pay to apply on LocalBacon

premises.text: LocalBacon provides a platform that allows job seekers to apply easily and receive feedback
premises.evidence_span: that's how easy it is for job seekers to apply on LocalBacon

premises.text: Employers can categorize and provide feedback on candidates through LocalBacon
premises.evidence_span: we try to make it as familiar for the employer and recruiter to use

value.text: LocalBacon improves the job application process for both job seekers and employers
value.evidence_span: We created LocalBacon to solve the fundamental problems that exist for both job seekers and employers

notes: No separate premises for ATS integration and candidate feedback as they are part of the same process.
